name: RealmsMUD core-lib
english_description: The official mudlib of RealmsMUD, a modern, actively-developed engine with a substantial shipped game world rather than a bare framework. New characters pass through an 11-step creation wizard (terminal color/charset setup, a live minimap demo, gender, race and subrace, hair and eye color, attribute allocation, and skill/trait selection) before landing in the world proper. 27 guilds span elemental casters (Aeromancer, Aquamancer, Cryomancer, Geomancer, Pyromancer), classic archetypes (Fighter, Mage, Ranger, Rogue, Bard, Druid, Necromancer), and setting-specific orders with their own lore (the Aegis Guard, the League of Assassins, the Hand of Bilanx, the Guardian of Khazurath, the Children of Ilyrth, Disciples of Argloth and Ferianth, the Werric Knights, Wrathguard, Runeskald, Oneiromancer, and Therianthrope shapeshifters). The shipped world includes named regions Argalen Keep, Eledhel, and Tol-Dhurath, alongside full quest, research/crafting, and player-trading systems. Login credentials and character records persist in a real backing MySQL database (RealmsLib) rather than flat player-save files, reflecting the engine's modern, service-oriented architecture.
